s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic, severe, mechanical low back pain and mental depression with cutaneous and subcutaneous lesions and muscle contractures
salient_findings: Large and deep, irregularly shaped, cutaneous ulcer on the right forearm
Woody induration of skin on forearms and abdominal region
Bilateral contracture of deltoid, triceps, and biceps muscles
key_facts: 7-year history of severe, mechanical, low back pain
Current medications include duloxetine hydrochloride, clonazepam, oxcarbazepine, fentanyl, sulpiride, zopiclone, omeprazole magnesium, and baclofen
Self-administering subcutaneous injections of meperidine, 100 mg 4 times per day, for the past 3 years
Cutaneous ulcer on the dorsum of right forearm with necrotic tissue and muscle exposure
Histopathology shows lobular panniculitis, subcutaneous fat lobules with necrotic adipocytes and dense inflammatory infiltrates

Subcutaneous fat necrosis of the newborn

shortlist.label: Factitial panniculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's history of self-administering subcutaneous injections of meperidine and presence of cutaneous ulcers and lobular panniculitis

shortlist.label: Meperidine-induced fibrosis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's long history of meperidine injections and presence of woody induration of skin and muscle contractures

shortlist.label: Eosinophilic fasciitis
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of woody induration of skin, muscle contractures, and elevated serum creatinine kinase

shortlist.label: Panniculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathology shows lobular panniculitis and subcutaneous fat lobules with necrotic adipocytes

shortlist.label: Lipodermatosclerosis
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of cutaneous ulcers, woody induration of skin, and history of chronic low back pain and mental depression
